tool_calls.name: run_sql
tool_calls.arguments:
{"query": "SELECT card_id, card_name, variant, low, mid, high, market, currency
FROM fct_daily_prices
WHERE set_id = 'sv03.5'
  AND source = 'tcgplayer'
  AND price_date = DATE '2026-11-10'
ORDER BY card_id, variant"}

replies.content:
TCGplayer prices for set sv03.5 on the latest date (2026-11-10), in USD:

| Card | Variant | Low | Market |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bulbasaur (sv03.5-001) | normal | $0.81 | $0.90 |
| Charizard ex (sv03.5-006) | holofoil | $261.00 | $290.00 |
| Pikachu (sv03.5-025) | normal | $2.88 | $3.20 |
